paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 6.89, representing a decrease of 6.89% from the prior close and 27.09% over the last 20 trading sessions.

There have been several recent SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031.
